info.title: WizardOS Tracker
info.description: Goals and Bugs on GitHub. Writes need application/json and a trusted Origin. 0.12: the human routes are for active members of humanitylabs-org signing in with their own (non-agent) GitHub account; refusals are 403 {error, reason: "not_member" | "agent"} and sign the saved account out. MCP (/mcp) is unchanged. 0.13: two-step review (Queued → Building → AI review [label ai-review] → Human review [label ready-to-test] → Done; AI review is agents-only via MCP ai_review_pass / ai_review_fail; policy human_reviews 1|2) and Sign in with GitHub via the OAuth device flow (no client secret).

get.summary: Goals or Bugs grouped by status: Waiting for review (ready-to-test, key test), Building (building), Queued (other open). Up to 300 items. Rows carry desc (first paragraph as plain text), assignees, comments (count). Also returns steps (the three workflow steps for this view), me_person, and per item opener (team name of whoever opened it); mine is true when you or your own agent opened it. 0.9: also returns targets (seconds per stage for this view: queued, building, review, done) and, for view=bugs, repos (every non-archived org repo as owner/name, cached an hour, so the Repo chips can show repos with 0 open bugs); items carry created_at and updated_at (bug age and sort are computed in the view). 0.10: names maps GitHub logins to the people names from the policy roster (owners and openers show these).

parameters.name: repos
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated repo names to keep (the view filters itself).

200.description: view, org, login, groups {test, building, queued} (each item: id, repo, number, title, author, assignees[], comments, desc, group, mine, labels; goals add progress, owner), counts, done (closed all time, null while stats are pending), stats (same shape as /api/stats, or {pending:true} until computed: then call /api/stats), total, shown, more; plus 0.3 keys test and doing. closed_week was removed in 0.5. 0.9 keys: targets {queued, building, review, done} in seconds; repos [owner/name] (bugs only, [] for goals).

get.summary: Bottleneck stats for one view from GitHub label history (LABELED/UNLABELED/CLOSED/REOPENED events), all open and closed issues of that kind, cached 5 minutes per account.

200.description: items [{id, repo, author, state, wait (s opened→first building), build (s first building→first ready-to-test), review_rounds ([s] each ready-to-test stint that ended in a close or kick-back), total (s opened→closed), tries (times labelled ready-to-test), kicks (ready-to-test removed without close/approved within 10 min), kick_to_done (s first kick-back→closed), waiting_for (s since ready-to-test, open items only), stage (queued|building|review|done), staged, opened_at, closed_at}], done, counted, total, computed_at, summary {wait_before_build, build_time, waiting_for_human, waiting_longest, tries_per_item, kicked_back, done, items, line {queued|building|review|done: {n, avg, box [min,p25,median,p75,max] or null under 3 points}, kick {reviewed, kicked, rate, per_item, to_done}}}. Null means no data yet. The view re-aggregates items after its author/repo filters with the same maths. 0.9: summary.line.<stage> also carries median, p25, p75 (p25/p75 from 3 data points).

post.summary: Sign in with GitHub (0.13, OAuth device flow, no client secret). The box POSTs https://github.com/login/device/code (scope "repo read:org") with the configured client id and starts polling https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token server-side (respecting interval, slow_down, expired_token, access_denied). Returns the user_code to type at verification_uri; the device_code never leaves the box.

404.description: No client id set (reason no_client_id): use the token paste flow.

502.description: GitHub refused or unreachable (reason = the GitHub error, e.g. device_flow_disabled).

get.summary: This person's device-flow sign-in: pending (keep showing the code), done (signed in; includes status), refused (not on the team or an agent account: reason not_member | agent; nothing saved), expired, denied, error, or none. The token goes through the same team + human-only checks as POST /api/connect and is stored the same way.

0.16 Is it on my Wizard? Body {box: {release, channel, apps: {app id: running version}}, items: [{id, delivers: [{repo, number, sha}], open_prs}]} (the page reads the box from store-install/_updates and /<app>/healthz). Answer {items: {id: {state: yes|no|unknown, text, fix, parts, apps}}, box}: a merged PR is on the box when its build contains the merge commit (GitHub compare: identical/ahead). fix: Update WizardOS in Settings | Switch to For testers in Settings | Update <App> | Needs a Mac app build | Not released yet. Cached; apps lists app ids whose version to send.
